title: An agent does not run a script another agent left in the shared scratchpad
why: A builder in lane notes-fix-large-1 ran probe2.py, which another agent had left in the shared scratchpad; no guard stopped it (lane report, 06:57 CST Nov 8).
note: Done check: a red test where the guard asks before an agent runs a scratchpad script it did not write, or a record says why per-agent scratch folders replace the check. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Slug from the lane; title by triage. Doing in lane session_013NEJL29GcaaeoS7a1SJYA2 (07:02 CST Nov 8). Second sighting (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, 07:24 CST Nov 8; proposed step agent-scratch-per-agent, folded here): a #1931 test-author took its commit message from a shared scratchpad file another agent had overwritten, and amended before the push. Harm stopped: a commit with another lane's message or trailers. The lane's fix: each spawned agent gets its own scratch sub-folder, or the guard refuses an agent's scratchpad write outside it. Lane plan (07:27 CST Nov 8): guard rule scratchpad-owner (decision scratchpad-owner, branch scratchpad-file-ownership) records which agent wrote each scratchpad file; the guard asks before another agent runs it, and, for #1931, before another agent overwrites it. One home: per-agent sub-folders are not built as a second fix, since an agent cannot learn its own id to name its folder and a folder convention has no check. Ready 09:23 CST Nov 8: #2023 handed to runner 8 (rounds 1 FAIL, 2 PASS, 3 PASS; net value positive). New debts: scratchpad-owner-runners, scratchpad-owner-record-flip, scratchpad-owner-cp-mv-dest. Second sighting (lane guard-checkout-path-restore, [ended:Lane:-bg-tail-loses-verdict], 15:23 CST Nov 8): about 15:00 CST a reviewer on #2269 extracted `git archive` copies into shared scratchpad folders `base` and `head`, maybe over round 1's hooks copies; it reported this itself. Hand-made worktrees are refused, so agents fall back to common scratch names. Proposed fix: a guard or scratchpad helper that gives each agent a folder named after it. Same need as lane revive-1042's note on frozen-path-mutant-install. #2023 covers running a script, not writing over a folder. Done: #2023 merged in batch 70 (PR #2498, 0e6509a96, 00:52 CST Nov 10). 03:01 CST Nov 13, note (coordinator, #3060): a round 3 reviewer's mutant command ran rm -rf on two scratch dirs in the shared scratchpad that another agent had used. They were scratch copies only, with no loss. Note only; it becomes a debt if it repeats.
